name: EPIC 210709047
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 13.1 solar radii and 1.96 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210709047 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM radius (solar radii) 13.108183 (16th-84th percentiles 12.472012-13.862975), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210709047 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.964585 (16th-84th percentiles 1.758386-2.227276), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210709047: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4863.107 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210709047 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2793.789062 (16th-84th percentiles 2671.601562-2939.023438), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.93 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 2,794 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 1.96 solar masses and 13.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,863 K at its surface.
